network: MNIST linear classifier, no hidden layer, 784x10
weight_quantization: symmetric signed int8, per-tensor scale, range -127..127
weight_tile_file_order: for tile 0..78, for out 0..9, one 80-bit row
weight_tile_lsb_rule: in mnist_linear_w_tile10_lsb.mem, Verilog word[8*k +: 8] is weight for input base+k
bias_file_order: out 0..9, one 32-bit two's-complement hex per line
